title_vi: Alice ở xứ sở diệu kỳ
translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Carroll’s deadpan, logical, child-clear narration is rendered in natural lively Vietnamese; the characters’ pedantry and rudeness are played straight.
decisions.rationale: The comedy depends on a straight face.

decisions.decision: Puns are re-created with Vietnamese double meanings where possible (trúng gió / không trúng for ‘fit’; thắt for ‘not/knot’) and never explained in the text.
decisions.rationale: A pun that needs a note is no longer a pun.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: The Fury tail-poem was flat unrhymed prose; recomposed as rhymed Vietnamese verse that keeps all fourteen source lines’ content in a single unit.
The axis/axes pun was dead (‘Trục ấy hả… chặt đầu nó đi’); re-created as a mishearing the Duchess can follow.
The ‘fit’ pun in units 759, 767 and 769 shared no word, so the King’s ‘It’s a pun!’ had nothing to point at; now ‘trúng gió’ / ‘không trúng’.
The malapropism ‘Antipathies’, the not/knot pun (88–90), the French-mouse logic (46) and the porpoise/purpose play were re-created.
The treacle ‘draw’ and ‘well in’ plays, the arithmetic parody and several address forms were corrected.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.source_term: the Mock Turtle / the Gryphon / the Mad Tea-Party
glossary.draft_rendering: Rùa Giả / Gryphon / Bữa trà điên
glossary.rationale: Character names are fixed and capitalised as names through the book.

glossary.draft_rendering: re-created in Vietnamese, with verse line counts unchanged
glossary.rationale: Carroll’s puns and the parodies of Victorian verse are recomposed as playful Vietnamese rather than glossed.

glossary.source_term: the Queen of Hearts / the King of Hearts / the Knave of Hearts
glossary.draft_rendering: Nữ Hoàng Cơ / Vua Cơ / Tên Bồi Cơ
glossary.rationale: The court cards are named as suits of Vietnamese cards.

glossary.draft_rendering: Alice says ‘tôi’ to everyone; the Rabbit says ‘cô’; the Queen and King ‘ta/ngươi’
glossary.rationale: One address system through the book.

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #11 (the Millennium Fulcrum edition 3.0), an electronic transcription of Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland (London: Macmillan, 1865; the Gutenberg text follows the later 1866 and 1897 Macmillan texts). The Gutenberg page does not name the exact printing and the text was not collated.

unresolved_questions.explanation: The axis/axes pun is re-created as an association rather than a true two-sense mishearing, and a few rhymes in the parody verses are slant.

title_review.target_title: Alice ở xứ sở diệu kỳ
title_review.rationale: The Vietnamese title ‘Alice ở xứ sở diệu kỳ’ is this edition’s own rendering; no earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The opening: Alice on the bank with her sister.
The closing: the sister’s dream of Alice grown up.
